title: Three classics — Für Elise, Canon in D, Ode to Joy

attribution.title: Für Elise, WoO 59
attribution.changes: Complete familiar opening form A A B-A B-A: the two written repeats are observed. The final alternative closes on A minor instead of leading into the next piano episode. Original opening melody and recognisable piano arpeggios converted to music-box plucks; melody is louder than the accompaniment.

attribution.title: Canon per 3 Violini e Basso
attribution.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for the consulted transcription
attribution.changes: Melody excerpt/reduction and independent music-box voicing, tempo adjusted to 57.5 quarter notes per minute, added closing cadence, and new event/geometry representation.

attribution.title: Ode to Joy
attribution.changes: The complete familiar 16-bar tune, including its middle phrase and ending, played twice; the second statement moves the melody up one octave. Melody transposed from the consulted G-major hymn setting to D major, with a newly made broken-chord accompaniment.
